text: Configure evaluators in the UI and auto-score experiment results with no code
quote: Configure evaluators in the Phoenix UI and attach them to your datasets. Phoenix scores experiment results automatically — no code required.

text: Model-agnostic judge via adapters (OpenAI, LiteLLM, LangChain, AI SDK, etc.)

quote: Dataset Evaluators serve as **test cases** that automatically score outputs when running experiments—forming an evaluation harness similar to a unit test suite.

text: Modular Python SDK lets you install only the components you need

text: Traces capture model calls, retrieval, tool use, and custom logic for debugging

quote: Every evaluation execution captures the input data, the exact prompts sent to the judge LLM, the model's full reasoning, the final scores, and execution timing.
